title: Nextera DNA Flex NGS Library Prep: Cleanup Libraries
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Centrifuge PCR plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the PCR plate generated in the Amplify Tagmented DNA step, then place the plate onto the Opentrons magnetic module.

steps.title: Load reservoir with reagents
steps.instruction: Place the 12‑channel reservoir (USA Scientific, 22 mL, catalog #1061‑8150) in slot 3 and fill channels as follows: channel 1 – SPB (vortex before mid‑protocol addition), channel 2 – nuclease‑free water, channel 3 – RSB, channels 4‑5 – ethanol, channels 10‑12 – empty liquid‑waste reservoir.

steps.title: Configure pipette parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons software, input the mount side and type for the P50 and P300 single/multi‑channel electronic pipettes, specify the DNA type, and enter the number of samples to process.

steps.title: Generate protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map: place the Bio‑Rad Hard Shell 96‑well low‑profile PCR plate (200 µL, #hsp9601) on the magnetic module, the 12‑channel reservoir in slot 3, the 4‑in‑1 tuberack with 2 mL Eppendorf tubes, and the 300 µL tipracks in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, calibrate the labware, tipracks, and both pipettes (P50 and P300) following the on‑screen instructions and support articles.

steps.title: Run cleanup protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App to start the Cleanup Libraries protocol.
